summary: Second-year Software Engineering student at the State University of Maringá (UEM), Brazil, focused on Data Engineering, cloud and AI.
At RR Transportes e Terraplanagem, I work in operations and built the fleet management ERP the company uses today.
At Main - Soluções em Software, I am an intern in sales and projects: prospecting, contract negotiation, requirements gathering and delivery tracking.
At UEM, I do undergraduate research (PIBIC) on Item Response Theory and AI. I co-organize Cloud Native Maringá, which plans to bring cloud events to the university starting in 2027.

projects.name: Logistics ERP
projects.summary: System that runs the operation of a trucking company: trips, costs, freight and maintenance, with a dashboard for the manager and an app for the driver that works without signal. It replaced spreadsheets, paper notes and WhatsApp messages in the management of a fleet of 9 trucks, which runs about 85 trips a month.
highlights: Financial result per trip, with manager review, commissions and fuel, maintenance and ad-hoc costs backed by receipt photos
Freight compared to the legal minimum rate (ANTT), with versioned tables updated from the official calculator
Expiration and mileage-based maintenance alerts, with push notifications
Security: scrypt-hashed passwords, revocable sessions, login attempt lockout and a strict CSP
Change auditing, daily backups and weekly restore tests
Automated tests (pytest and Playwright) and CI on GitHub Actions, with dependency scanning
projects.architectureTitle: Production architecture, on a Linux VPS
projects.deployment: In production on a Linux VPS, with nginx, HTTPS (Let's Encrypt) and services isolated by systemd
